test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Observe the following triangles A, B, C and D. Triangle A represents the number of people who play football. Triangle B represents the number of people who play basketball .Triangles C and D represent the number of people who play tennis and volleyball, respectively. How many people play football or basketball but NOT tennis?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/733c5eaebd553967604f1def9298c0049fc1f9b50725df554a593d2d3f48d6e3.png]
solution:
The region that best represents the number of people who play football or basketball but NOT tennis is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d14bc8910b964ecad95b59534e79b001fd269ae659c293f8c657da76860e40.png] 

Here, the marked area shows the number of people who play football or basketball but NOT tennis.

So, the number of people who play football or basketball but NOT tennis = (1 + 3 + 2 + 4 + 7) ⇒ 17

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
